description.value: The Wobbly Canoe is a locally owned and operated restaurant situated on the shore of Davis Bay, right on the Sunshine Coast Highway — positioning it as a natural first stop for cyclists arriving on the Sunshine Coast. The menu leans into locally sourced seafood and comfort food, with dishes like fresh mussels, fish and chips, prawn ceviche, and braised beef bowls alongside craft beer. It promotes itself as a gathering spot for post-adventure refueling with locally sourced ingredients and quality drink.

address.value: 4774 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Sechelt, BC V7Z 0E6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms a real, operating restaurant at 4774 Sunshine Coast Hwy in Sechelt, BC. Phone number matches between OSM and website; however, opening hours differ significantly (OSM lists Tu-Sa 15:00-20:00 while the website shows Mon-Sun 12-8), flagged as a concern. The menu explicitly references takeout availability and labels many dishes with 'gf' and 'df' tags, and includes a dedicated veggie sandwich and crispy tofu poke option.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM lists Tu-Sa 15:00-20:00 but website shows Mon-Sun 12:00-20:00. OSM hours should be updated.
Email domain inconsistency: OSM lists info@wobblycanoe.com but website shows contact emails at wobbly-canoe.com (peyton@wobbly-canoe.com, info@wobbly-canoe.com).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant on the Sunshine Coast Highway at Davis Bay — a natural and well-positioned stop for touring cyclists. Website confirms active business with full menu.

Takeout.detail: Website menu note states '*PLEASE NOTE NOT ALL ITEMS ARE AVAILABLE FOR TAKE OUT', confirming takeout exists though with a limited selection

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a Veggie Sandwich, crispy tofu poke bowl option, and marks many dishes with 'gf' (gluten-free) and 'df' (dairy-free) options or modifications. Handhelds section notes 'all handhelds can be made gluten free and dairy free'
